title: Portable Tester Tool
what: A portable PCB testing tool for in-field firmware flashing and diagnostics, equipped with essential electronics including a battery for portable use, USB ports, required PCB harnesses, and a responsive touchscreen with a simple GUI. Features include port covers and cutouts for easy access to USB connections.
why: Designed for developers and clients who need a compact, user-friendly solution for flashing and debugging PCBs in the field, minimizing delays from limited remote support or return wait times. Combines all essential tools and electronics for working with products in a clean, streamlined enclosure.
how: Designed an enclosure in CAD with compartments for the screen, battery, ports, and test board. Assembled the tool with 3D printing and organized internal wiring to components. Programmed a GUI on a Raspberry Pi 5 embedded in the tool to streamline firmware flashing and device diagnostics during field use.
